headers.//: The whisper probe needs SharedArrayBuffer (ORT's WASM threads), which requires cross-origin isolation. COOP/COEP are PER-DOCUMENT and this app is an SPA where a route is not a document — so the probe is a real standalone document under public/ and only IT is isolated. Isolating the app itself would be a much larger decision (it constrains every future cross-origin subresource). NOTE: this grants NO microphone — a latency benchmark does not need one, so `microphone=()` below stays untouched.
